title: Boran-2022-persistent-10.1016/j.neuroimage.2022.119123
description: Intracranial EEG recorded from depth electrodes in the medial temporal lobe (amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal and parahippocampal cortex) of patients with drug-resistant epilepsy at University Hospital Zurich. Participants performed a visual working memory change-detection task with set sizes of 1, 2, 4 or 6 items. This is a BIDS-iEEG conversion of the continuous LFP series from the authors' NWB release on DANDI (000575), with corrected sampling rates and amplitude units, MNI electrode coordinates, and trial-level events.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Neuralynx ATLAS system (32 kHz, hardware passband 1-8000 Hz). The authors exported them via FieldTrip to NWB, and most sessions were downsampled to 4 kHz. The NWB data were converted to BrainVision BIDS-iEEG as float32 microvolts. The sampling rate was verified from the 50 Hz mains peak, series coverage, and timestamps. No filtering, resampling or re-referencing was applied. Events were derived from the NWB trial, epoch and response tables.
